name: 四邊留邊的圓角輪播卡片＋中央大標題，卡片下方一行置中文字
desc: 四邊留邊、四角圓角的卡片內是多張滿版圖片的自動輪播，大標題固定在卡片正中央；卡片下方的窄條中央放置中的副標，左側留邊處有旋轉成直向的捲動提示。
prompt: 主視覺是卡片，上方與左右兩側留邊，下方留一條窄條；四個角（左上、右上、左下、右下）都做圓角。卡片約佔畫面寬的九成、主視覺高度的大部分。卡片內是多張滿版背景圖片的自動輪播，每張停留數秒，停留期間圖片緩慢放大，接著下一張由下往上擦入蓋過前一張，播完最後一張後回到第一張繼續；大標題與其他文字固定不動，不跟著圖片換。卡片正中央放大標題（可多行），水平置中、垂直置中，約佔卡片寬的三分之一；大標題上方可放小標籤、下方可放副標，沒有內容時省略，大標題位置不變。卡片下方的窄條中央可放副標，沒有內容時省略，窄條仍保留。
mobile: 仍撐滿一個畫面，高度要避免網址列伸縮造成跳動。卡片四邊留邊與四個角的圓角都不變，左右留邊變窄；背景圖片改為直式裁切。大標題仍在卡片正中央，寬度改為約佔卡片寬的七成，完整落在卡片內不超出邊緣。卡片下方窄條的副標保留。輪播保留，切換方式不變。

en.name: Rounded slideshow card with margins on all sides, centered headline and a centered line of text below
en.desc: A card with margins on all four sides and all four corners rounded holds an auto-playing slideshow of full-bleed images, with the headline fixed at the exact center; a strip below the card holds a centered subheading, and the left margin carries a scroll indicator rotated to read vertically.
en.prompt: The hero is a card with margins on the top, left and right, with a narrow strip left below it; all four corners (top-left, top-right, bottom-left and bottom-right) are rounded. The card takes about ninety percent of the viewport width and most of the hero's height. Inside the card is an auto-playing slideshow of multiple full-bleed background images; each one stays for a few seconds while slowly zooming in, then the next one wipes in from the bottom upward over the previous one, and after the last one it returns to the first and continues. The headline and other text stay fixed and do not change with the images. Place a headline (may wrap to multiple lines) at the exact center of the card, horizontally and vertically centered, about one third of the card's width; optionally place a label above the headline and a subheading below it; omit them when there is no content, without changing the position of the headline. Optionally place a subheading centered in the strip below the card; omit it when there is no content, and keep the strip.
en.mobile: Still fills one viewport; avoid height jumps caused by the mobile address bar expanding and collapsing. The card keeps margins on all four sides and all four rounded corners, with narrower left and right margins; the background images are cropped to portrait. The headline stays at the exact center of the card, its width changes to about seventy percent of the card's width, and it stays fully inside the card without overflowing its edges. The subheading in the strip below the card is kept. The slideshow is kept with the same transition.

accessories.prompt: 在主視覺左下角、卡片左側的留邊處放一個捲動提示：一個旋轉成直向的小標籤，下方排幾個小三角形，依序亮起、持續循環。

en.prompt: Place a scroll indicator in the bottom-left corner of the hero, in the margin to the left of the card: a small label rotated to read vertically, with a few small triangles below it that light up one after another in a continuous loop.
